# telnyx_wireless_blocklist_values (Data Source)

The values a wireless blocklist of a type (country, mcc or plmn) can hold. `data` is a JSON list whose element shape depends on the type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_wireless_blocklist_values" "countries" {
  type = "country"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The Wireless Blocklist type for which to list possible values (e.g., `country`, `mcc`, `plmn`). One of `country`, `mcc`, `plmn`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
